verdict.rationale: Insomnia lints OpenAPI specs automatically in the design view, showing error type, line number and message. The Inso CLI can run `inso lint spec` in CI, fail builds on errors and return pass/fail exit codes. However, nothing in the pack shows that the lint rules can be configured or extended with custom style or governance rules, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: evidence of configurable or custom rulesets (style guides, governance policies), rule severity tuning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the linting.
